result.paraphrase: Seagate Enterprise Capacity V.5 6TB Hard Drive, model ST6000NM0095, is a 3.5-inch internal HDD with a SAS-12Gbps interface. It offers 6 TB of storage, 512E sectors, dual interface ports, and a 256 MB buffer. Performance specs include 7200 RPM rotational speed, 226 MBPS maximum sustained transfer rate OD, and 4.16 MS average latency. Built with a humidity sensor, halogen-free design, and PowerChoice technology, it has an MTBF of 2 million hours and a rotational vibration rating of 12.5 at 1500 Hz (RAD/S²).
